overallSummary: Fabio Giglietto maintains a highly active and specialized academic social media presence across Bluesky, LinkedIn, and Mastodon, totaling 3,580 followers. Content is tightly focused on computational social science, disinformation, social media analysis tools like CooRnet, and academic recruiting. Engagement is exceptionally strong relative to follower counts, indicating a highly relevant, professional audience that actively interacts with announcements of research publications, grants, and software tools.

contentThemes.description: Research updates, conference announcements, and paper publications detailing computational methods to analyze coordinated inauthentic behavior and social media disinformation campaigns.
Job openings and academic opportunities, including hiring postdoctoral researchers and recruiting PhD students for computational social science teams.
Announcements regarding major research achievements, such as securing funding grants and releasing new versions of open-source research software like CooRnet.

recommendations: Increase post frequency on LinkedIn and Mastodon where posting volumes are currently low but follower bases are strong and receptive.
Leverage Bluesky's highly interactive environment for early feedback on research and student outreach, as it currently yields the highest engagement rate.
Utilize rich media, such as direct links to research papers, screenshots of CooRnet tool updates, and visual infographics, to further boost click-through rates across all networks.

platformInsights.bluesky: Bluesky acts as the most engaging platform with an average engagement rate of 6.14% per post. It serves as an excellent hub for real-time academic discussions, networking, and attracting prospective PhD candidates.
platformInsights.mastodon: With an average engagement rate of 4.55% per post, Mastodon provides a dedicated niche audience ideal for technical tool releases (e.g., CooRnet updates) and decentralized scholarly communications.
platformInsights.linkedin: LinkedIn has the largest audience (1,850 followers) and yields the highest absolute engagement numbers per post. It is the premier platform for professional milestones, grant announcements, and recruiting postdoctoral researchers.
